# contextforge_team (Data Source)

Data source for looking up a ContextForge team by ID



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Team ID for lookup

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `created_by` (String) Email address of the user who created the team
- `description` (String) Team description
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the team is active
- `is_personal` (Boolean) Whether this is a personal team
- `max_members` (Number) Maximum number of members allowed in the team
- `member_count` (Number) Current number of members in the team
- `name` (String) Team name
- `slug` (String) Team slug (URL-friendly identifier)
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `visibility` (String) Visibility setting (public, private, etc.)
